analysis:
This is just an iteration of a tier list - feel free to make and share your own! The general guiding principle for us is that damage-per-shot matters more than rate of fire. Armor reduction and falloff apply to every hit, so fewer hits means less damage lost to falloff and mitigated by armor. That is why the FAL outranks the faster 5.56 rifles, which all do an identical 28 damage and separate only on fire rate and muzzle velocity.

Lower down, most weapons fall into their placements because they cannot break through into higher tiers rather than being a "bad weapon". For example, the Super-45 has the highest close-range output in the game and still sits in A tier, because it pretty much stops working past 50 meters.
